description: This file defines the MyReviewAPI class, which is a REST API endpoint for listing performance reviews assigned to the authenticated user within the OrangeHRM HR management system. It implements a method to retrieve paginated review data, leveraging traits and DAO services for data access, and conforms to the overall API structure with validation rules and unimplemented CRUD operations.

classes.name: MyReviewAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for fetching the list of performance reviews associated with the authenticated user. Provides implementations for listing reviews and validation rules. Other CRUD methods are not implemented.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of performance reviews for the current user, including total count, using performance review service and DAO.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for parameters when fetching the list of reviews, focusing on sorting and pagination.
